contentPattern.structure: heading + subheading + paragraph on left column, 1 rounded cover image on right column, no CTAs

suitableFor: FAQ page intros with text + single supporting image
help center landing pages with two-column hero layout
informational page openers without call-to-action buttons
notSuitableFor: blog listing / index pages with CTAs (use hero-blog)
blog article detail headers with breadcrumbs + byline (use hero-blog-post)
full-bleed image banners with text overlay (use hero-banner)
homepage hero with stacked image gallery (use hero-trendsetters)
